description: T-5123 (SPEC-0039 U2, the column twin of t5123-insert-row-last-row-nonblank): insert_column A on S when S's last column holds a plain nonblank cell (S!XFD1 is 5, no table): does Excel refuse the insert (the answer wanted is then the refusal and its error code), or drop the cell? Sheet F holds A1 =S!XFD1, A2 FORMULATEXT(A1), A3 =COUNTA(S!1:1) (is the 5 still on the sheet), A4 FORMULATEXT(A3).
